name: recruiter-bff
description: A recruiter that works for you. Paste a job posting and find out if you're a match before you apply: a score from 1 to 5, the key requirements checked against your resume, and a straight answer to apply or skip. Land the interview and it builds you a guide with the role, your fit, your gaps, and questions to ask. A story bank keeps your best answers for applications and interviews. It also scans for fresh roles, tracks your applications, and helps with your resume and LinkedIn. It never applies for you. Plain files you own. Formerly Job Search Agent.

interface.shortDescription: Find out if you're a match before you apply, then walk in prepared.
interface.longDescription: Paste a job posting and it tells you honestly whether you fit, gaps included, and whether to apply. When the interview comes, it builds a guide from your own background. It never applies for you, and that's the point: fewer, better applications, sent sooner.
defaultPrompt: Set me up for my job search
Is this role a good fit for me?
